'''Rejeff's Legion''' was an irregular unit of volunteers who rose up against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Led by [[Diew Rejeff]], they fought alongside the [[Mos Eisley Security Squad]] and [[Cantina Commandos]] during the [[Rebellion on Tatooine]].<ref name="Sand" />
